name: How can I make my small outdated bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small outdated bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom feel larger, consider incorporating light-colored tiles and paint, which reflect more light. Using large format tiles with minimal grout lines can create a seamless look. Opt for a floating vanity to free up floor space and a glass shower enclosure instead of a shower curtain. Strategic lighting, well-placed mirrors, and recessed niches in the shower can also enhance the feeling of spaciousness without altering the footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use light colors, large tiles, a floating vanity, glass shower enclosures, and strategic lighting to make a small bathroom feel larger.
